note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (acting President Putin, early in the Second Chechen War and after the 1998 financial crisis), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: powerful security and military establishments, large business groups formed in 1990s privatisation, weak independent unions and a partly state-owned broadcast media.
